name: Thame GLOF 2024
subtitle: Thame valley, Solukhumbu, Nepal · cascading glacial lake outburst, 16 Aug 2024
description: Showcase workspace. Reported evidence is loaded; satellite rasters (DEM, Sentinel-1, NISAR) and mapped footprints are listed under 'Awaiting data' with instructions.

region.name: Thame valley, Solukhumbu, Nepal
region.centerNote: Map centre is the approximate location of Thame village; no event geometry is drawn until mapped footprints are added.

datasets.name: Event evidence workbook
datasets.description: Lake areas, drained volumes, timing, climate context, impacts, flow-model scenarios, scene inventory and caveats, transcribed from published sources.

datasets.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.howTo: Download the Copernicus GLO-30 tile covering Thame (N27 E086) e.g. via OpenTopography or the AWS open-data bucket, clip to the valley, save as dem_glo30.tif in frontend/public/workspaces/thame-2024/ and set "url": "dem_glo30.tif" here.

datasets.name: Sentinel-1 RTC (before event)
datasets.howTo: In ASF Vertex, find a Sentinel-1 IW scene over Thame acquired shortly BEFORE 16 Aug 2024, order an RTC product via HyP3 (free Earthdata login), and add the VV GeoTIFF here with its acquisition date.

datasets.name: Sentinel-1 RTC (after event)
datasets.howTo: Same orbit/track as the 'before' scene, acquired AFTER 16 Aug 2024 (the evidence workbook lists a 19 Aug 2024 Sentinel-1 acquisition used by Sentinel Asia). Process with HyP3 RTC using the same settings, add the VV GeoTIFF with its date, then run 'Detect change'.

datasets.name: NISAR L-band scene (2025–2026)
datasets.howTo: NISAR launched in 2025, so it cannot show the 2024 event itself. Search ASF Vertex for NISAR GCOV products over Thame to show the valley's current state; coverage for this location still needs to be checked.

datasets.name: UNOSAT landslide/mudslide scars
datasets.howTo: UNOSAT product LS20240818NPL (preliminary, not field-validated, ~140 ha). If the GIS layer is available, convert it to GeoJSON (WGS84) and add it here.

datasets.name: JAXA ALOS-2 flood proxy map
datasets.howTo: Sentinel Asia lists a shapefile set for the 24 Aug 2024 ALOS-2 flood proxy map. Convert to GeoJSON (WGS84) and add it here.
